name: 分類と個別メモをまとめる保存地点の一覧
prompt:
Create one portrait Japanese saved-places list component on a clean white canvas, matching the mobile crop proportions and hierarchy of the supplied references.

Reference priority:
1) The original full list crop controls screen geometry, content hierarchy, row rhythm, dividers, filter/search controls and photo positions.
2) The two square source-photo crops are protected original listing photographs. Preserve each photograph and its visible crop as faithfully as possible: photo 1 is a turquoise-lidded teapot pouring into a striped bowl; photo 2 is a small jazz ensemble with double bass, grand piano and a seated pianist. Do not replace, redraw, add details, recolor or filter either photo.
3) The Japanese preview controls the exact localized copy, selected tab, green palette, two-row scope and adapted component styling. Use exactly the visible preview content; do not add the source screenshot's third partially visible listing.

Build the header with title “保存した場所” and a rounded map button labeled “地図”. Below it show four tabs: “訪問済み” active in Lighthouse green with a short underline, then “行きたい”, “おすすめ”, and “コレクション” in muted gray. Add one filter-control row with the sort-sliders icon, outlined “都市” and “分類” dropdowns, a search icon and a right-pointing share/action arrow.

Show exactly two saved-place rows, each with the supplied photo at the left, its Japanese title, the rating tiles and metadata, a thin three-line reorder handle on the right, and a pale mint note field below the text. Row 1 exact copy: “1. 地域の食堂”, four green square star tiles and one gray tile, “4.2 (2千件)”, location “渋谷区・料金の目安 ¥¥¥”, categories “食事・カフェ・麺料理”, placeholder “メモを書く…”. Row 2 exact copy: “2. 音楽のある交流室”, four green square star tiles and one gray tile, “4.2 (2千件)”, location “渋谷区・料金の目安 ¥¥¥”, categories “食事・カフェ・麺料理”, placeholder “メモを書く…”. Keep the copy and order exactly as listed. Separate the two rows with a light-gray divider.

Use the preview's restrained compact spacing, white background, thin gray borders, near-black text, muted metadata, pale mint note fields and #2D8F5E active accents. Use Meiryo-style Japanese sans-serif: titles Bold 20/28 and supporting text Regular 14/24, letter spacing 0. Keep the canvas portrait and close to the reference ratio.

Do not add a device frame, status bar, bottom navigation, extra list row, unrelated text, extra stars, watermark, or decorative background. Keep both protected photos recognizable and unchanged in subject, color, crop and visible details.
